🎥🎬: The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum (2027)

Long before the final battle for Middle-earth, a dangerous hunt begins when Gandalf discovers that Gollum may possess information capable of revealing the location of the One Ring. Knowing that Sauron is searching for the Ring, Gandalf turns to Aragorn, a skilled Ranger known as Strider, and sends him on a mission to track down the mysterious creature before the enemy can find him.

Aragorn’s pursuit takes him across the dangerous wilderness of Middle-earth, following the trail of a creature torn between his two identities: Sméagol and Gollum. As the hunt intensifies, Gollum’s dark past and his connection to the One Ring become increasingly important to the fate of the entire world.

Directed by Andy Serkis, this new chapter explores an untold part of Tolkien’s legendary story, revealing the events surrounding Gollum’s capture and the desperate search for answers that leads directly into The Fellowship of the Ring.
